They don't even have an X-ray machine on-site to make a diagnosis. Right after my one-star review, several five-star reviews appeared to boost the rating. It really gives the impression that the rating is artificially inflated to attract customers.

Avoid at all costs ⚠️
I brought my cat in specifically requesting a haircut, as he had many mats and the heatwave was approaching.

The veterinarian, Ms. Fiocre, heavily anesthetized my cat, not to shave him as requested, but simply to brush him. Upon returning home, I discovered a large, bright red blood stain under his neck, which they must have created without ever mentioning it to me when I picked him up. His condition was clearly excessively anesthetized. I don't know the exact dose, but it was extreme.

When I reported the problem, I was accused of not being clear, even though I had specifically requested a haircut, not a brushing, which I could easily have done myself without anesthesia. I find this unacceptable, especially since I had already visited this same clinic in 2023 for the exact same reason, with a completely different outcome.

I've never seen my cat in such a state. At the time, another vet treated him with far more seriousness and respect.

The result was appalling, the treatment disrespectful, and there was no self-reflection other than blaming the client to avoid admitting any responsibility. What a lack of professionalism!

I will never set foot in that place again. I highly recommend Les Vétos Parisiens next door: much friendlier, more professional, and more respectful.

Take care of your animals!!

I am deeply shocked by the utter lack of humanity I experienced today.

I had made an appointment for a kitten I recently rescued, only two months old. I was 15 minutes late because I stopped to buy him water and food. Upon arrival, I immediately apologized and explained the situation, worried because I knew nothing about his health.

Despite this, I was refused any consultation. Even worse, although slots were still available on their system and I had booked another appointment for 4:40 PM when it was only 4:30 PM, I was asked to leave simply because I hadn't called to let them know I would be late.

Prioritizing a rule or one's ego over the health of a vulnerable animal is, in my eyes, profoundly inhumane. I am disgusted by this complete lack of compassion and, in shock, I went home in tears. I understand why this doctor has 100 free slots per day.

My dog ​​(a 4-year-old Chihuahua) has been treated at this clinic for three years. Annual vaccinations and a veterinary certificate for outpatient visits. The doctors are very competent, professional, and the prices are reasonable.
